info.name: GATEWAY-RUST
info.description:
Functional and security tests for the app/ RBAC gateway (Rust, axum, Diesel, JWT).

Base URL defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8080. Run `cargo run -p gateway` in app/ first.

Folders:
- 0. Bootstrap: register + log in an admin, a viewer and a never-privileged bystander, capturing tokens and ids into environment variables.
- Health / Auth / Users / Roles / Permissions: the functional API, happy paths and expected failures.
- Wallet: Apple Wallet passes - sample catalog, issue (serial + per-pass token + QR), edit, public .pkpass download, and the pass-update web service authenticated with 'Authorization: ApplePass <token>'. Tolerates 503 when signing material is absent.
- Security: penetration tests. These assert the defence HOLDS â€” a passing security test means the attack was correctly refused, not that it worked.

Everything a request needs (tokens, ids) is captured by earlier requests into variables, so the folders run top to bottom with the Collection Runner.
